lines: Your brain often pays more attention
One rude comment can stay in your head
even after ten people praise you.
This is called the negativity bias.
So don’t let one bad moment
that is happening in your life.
Follow for more daily videos that help you understand people.

caption: If this felt like you, save it and send it to someone who needs to hear it.
